# Tabs

Section tabs inside a workspace; the selected tab gets a 2px accent-crimson underline and full ink-primary text.

`PhantomPortals.Tabs` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Tabs tabs={…} />
```

```html

```

## Notes
